title: Store path to current POTD image in in its config file to enable various useful purposes for other software
line: The Picture of the Day wallpaper now saves the path of the picture it shows in its settings, so other apps can use it.
explanation: The Picture of the Day wallpaper kept its downloaded image only in its cache and wrote nothing about it to its config, so tools that read the wallpaper config (Latte Dock back then, theming and colour scripts now) could not find the picture being shown, unlike with the Image wallpaper. The wallpaper now has an Image entry, and once a picture has loaded it writes that picture's path there (only when it changed), using the same key name as the Image wallpaper.

commits.message:
wallpapers/potd: store the path of the current image in the config

Other software had no way to know which picture the Picture of the Day
wallpaper is showing. Once an image has loaded, its path is now written
to the wallpaper's config as Image, like the Image wallpaper does.

BUG: 445643

patches.diff:
From 1bd94cf5d9f0918283c54a15b84355de158998bd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 22:43:56 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpapers/potd: store the path of the current image in the
 config

Other software had no way to know which picture the Picture of the Day
wallpaper is showing. Once an image has loaded, its path is now written
to the wallpaper's config as Image, like the Image wallpaper does.

BUG: 445643
---
 wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml | 4 ++++
 wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml     | 4 ++++
 2 files changed, 8 insertions(+)

diff --git a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml
index a66b98e5c..b148c0d93 100644
--- a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -22,6 +22,10 @@
       <label>Update wallpaper over metered connection. 0 - False, 1 - True, 2 - True when data usage is below limit (not implemented)</label>
       <default>0</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="Image" type="String">
+      <label>Path of the image currently shown, for other software to read</label>
+      <default></default>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml
index b179ce7e6..5f0a33769 100644
--- a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -73,6 +73,10 @@ WallpaperItem {
                 return;
             }
             imageView.pendingImage.statusChanged.disconnect(imageView.replaceWhenLoaded);
+            if (imageView.pendingImage.status === Image.Ready && root.configuration.Image !== backend.localUrl) {
+                root.configuration.Image = backend.localUrl;
+                root.configuration.writeConfig();
+            }
             imageView.replace(imageView.pendingImage, {}, imageView.doesSkipAnimation ? QQC2.StackView.Immediate : QQC2.StackView.Transition);
             imageView.pendingImage = null;
         }
--

media.caption: Master: the wallpaper config has only Provider=apod, no path to the picture shown
With the fix: Image= holds the path of the picture shown

reviews.text: Directly implements the requested Solution 2a by adding an Image config entry to the Picture of the Day wallpaper and writing backend.localUrl to it once the image finishes loading. Writing only when Image.Ready and the path actually changed avoids redundant config syncs on startup, and omitting cfg_Image from config.qml avoids interfering with the wallpaper settings dialog. The before/after screenshots and Bing provider-switch verification cleanly prove the behavior.

This implements what Nate scoped the bug to in c6 (solution 2a): a kcfg Image entry in the POTD wallpaper's own group, written once the image has loaded and only when the path changed. backend.localUrl is a QString path, so the !== check works and the config is not rewritten on every reload. The before/after config screenshots and the APOD to Bing switch prove it, and the commit message matches the small diff. Two nits, neither blocking: the Image wallpaper stores a file:// URL under the same key while this stores a plain path, and because the cache path stays the same per provider, tools that only watch appletsrc are not told about a new daily image. The notes state both.
